reference.title: Salesforce Method Action
reference.shortdesc: is being deprecated and will be retired in a future release. It is not recommended

section.p: Salesforce Method action is being deprecated and will be retired in a future release. It is not recommended to use this action during App development. You should use an individual or list field based trigger to simulate a method call to Salesforce.
Salesforce Method relates to Salesforce environment only and hence not supported in Microsoft Dynamics and Apttus Omni.
The Salesforce Method action enables you to call Salesforce Apex classes.
